operations.summary: Force-field solar modulation (Gleeson and Axford 1968) of one point of one isotope: E_LIS = E_TOA + |Z| phi in total kinetic energy, J_TOA = (2mE + E^2)/(2mE' + E'^2) J_LIS times dE/dx at TOA over LIS for a flux per unit of the chosen variable. --modulate: a LIS power law or table to the TOA flux; --demodulate: one measured TOA flux to the LIS energy and flux. Called per isotope (its Z, A and mass) as a subprocess by propagation fits (cr-propagation plan Q4); a one-parameter effective model without drifts, latitude dependence or transients. With --phi-uncertainty the output adds phi_uncertainty_gv and sigma_flux_toa_from_phi (modulate) or sigma_flux_lis_from_phi (demodulate); with a power law it echoes lis_normalization and lis_index, with a table lis_table

inputs.name: modulate
inputs.constraint: flag; exactly one of modulate and demodulate: forward model, a LIS (power law or table) to the predicted TOA flux

inputs.name: demodulate
inputs.constraint: flag; exactly one of modulate and demodulate: one measured TOA flux point inverted to the LIS energy and flux

inputs.name: energy
inputs.constraint: finite, > 0; the TOA value of the energy variable chosen by energy_kind ({E} = GeV, GeV/n or GV)

inputs.name: energy_kind
inputs.constraint: Ek_total (GeV), Ek_per_nucleon (GeV/n, needs mass_number) or rigidity (GV); fluxes are per unit of this variable

inputs.name: mass
inputs.constraint: finite, > 0; rest mass of the whole nucleus

inputs.name: mass_number
inputs.constraint: positive integer >= charge; needed for Ek_per_nucleon (the shift is then (|Z|/A) phi per nucleon)

inputs.name: phi
inputs.constraint: finite, >= 0; one effective force-field potential in phi_unit; applied per isotope (Z, A), never to a ratio

inputs.name: phi_unit
inputs.constraint: GV or MV; the unit {P} of phi and phi_uncertainty

inputs.name: phi_uncertainty
inputs.constraint: finite, >= 0; 1-sigma, propagated to the derived flux by a central difference

inputs.name: lis_normalization
inputs.constraint: (modulate, power law) finite, > 0: A in J_LIS(x) = A x^-gamma, x in energy_kind units; with lis_index, not with lis_table

inputs.name: lis_table
inputs.constraint: (modulate) JSON {"variable": <energy_kind>, "points": [[x, flux], ...]} with at least two distinct x, log-log interpolated, no extrapolation; not with the power-law inputs

inputs.name: toa_flux
inputs.constraint: (demodulate, required there) finite, > 0: the measured flux at the TOA energy

inputs.name: status
inputs.constraint: one of the core artifact_statuses; echoed as status

failure_states.meaning: an unexpected internal error (not reached for valid or invalid input): a traceback on stderr, nothing on stdout

an argument is missing, malformed, non-finite or out of range (including both or neither of --modulate and --demodulate, a missing LIS or --toa-flux, an LIS table that is unreadable or would be extrapolated, or a non-finite result); one JSON object with status failed and error_kind invalid-input on stdout, the usage on stderr
